description: Anime Ball Duels is a Roblox PvP collector where anime characters appear as battle balls. Codes hand out coins, gems, and trait crystals for gacha pulls after you finish the trial duels.
redeemSteps: Join the King Games TD Community group and like/favorite the game on Roblox.
Launch Anime Ball Duels and finish the required trial duels so the Codes button unlocks.
Open the Codes icon in the upper-right corner, paste a code exactly, then hit Redeem.
